changelog:
v3.6.3 — Captions Fix + Faster Startup

Subtitles / CC
• Fixed: captions stopped working after v3.6.0 upgrade. Cue listener was orphaned on every player rebuild (software decoder fallback, FFmpeg audio rebuild) and killed subtitle delivery mid-playback. Now re-attached on every rebuild path.
• Fixed: MKV movies played through libVLC had zero subtitle plumbing — subtitle menu returned 'unavailable in compatible mode'. libVLC backend now has a real Audio Track / Subtitle Track picker on the Tracks button. Tapping CC auto-selects English subs where available.

Performance
• Live TV first-frame is ~400–800ms faster: tuned LoadControl to prioritize playback-duration over byte thresholds and dropped initial-playback buffer to 500ms.
• Shield / AFTKRT / capable Android TVs now force the highest HLS variant the server publishes — no more getting stuck at 720p when 1080p is available.
• VOD / Series resume is instant: resume position is now passed into setMediaItem so the player buffers from the resume offset directly. No more 2–3 seconds of opening logo before jumping to where you left off.
• Returning from player to Home no longer re-shimmers every poster grid — we stopped nuking the image memory cache on player start.
• libVLC video options tuned for streaming — removed --no-skip-frames and --no-drop-late-frames which were forcing lipsync drift on MKV movies on slower devices.

Interaction
• Fixed: OK / Enter on the bottom controls bar was hijacking every button and just toggling play/pause on libVLC-backed playback. Buttons now do what they say.
